findings.text: Exporter operation set exposes mapping pair plus lifecycle and CPU coordination hooks. Mapping creation and teardown plus final release are required. CPU access begin and end plus address space mapping are elective. Kernel virtual mapping pair is also present. Direction argument accompanies mapping and CPU steps.

Mapping hook provides device addressable scatter description for a given attachment. Result addresses observe page granularity. Failure is conveyed as encoded negative error, including interruption by signal. Exporter must allocate fresh description per call and hand ownership to caller; importer returns it through unmap path.

Unmapping hook reclaims description created by mapping hook and may release pinned backing when last device view disappears. Release hook runs after final reference drop to destroy buffer object. Both are compulsory for exporters.

CPU coordination follows bracket pattern where begin prepares coherence for stated direction and end undoes preparation after importer finishes. Same path serves user mappings through synchronization ioctl and kernel mappings through virtual mapping. Begin may optimize flushing by direction; mismatched use can expose stale content. Both directions report interruption restart codes and allocation failures.

User mapping is defined incoherent so callers must bracket access with explicit synchronization. Buffer extent never changes, therefore core validates virtual area size and exporter need not repeat that test. Exporters needing manual cache upkeep must install private file and offset to obtain distinct address space for range invalidation; graphics exporters may reuse existing shared memory file with zero offset.

Shared buffer object carries fixed length, sharing file, attachment list, operation vector, virtual mapping count and current mapping, exporter label, optional user label with guard, owning module, accounting link, private exporter data, reservation object, wait queue and two poll callbacks for input and output readiness.

Attachment collection plus virtual mapping count and pointer are serialized by reservation object. User label accesses use dedicated spin guard. Poll state and accounting links show no explicit guard in this fragment.

Exporter label is compulsory debug string and never absent. User label defaults to absent and when present includes terminator within bounded length. Owner points at exporting module for lifetime pinning. Lifetime and sharing use file reference count.

Implicit coordination requires read classification to record read usage fence and write classification to record write usage fence. Always recording write usage is permitted as over synchronization. Purely synchronous user interfaces record nothing. Dependency collection uses combined read-write view. All memory handling must honor reservation usage rules.

Dynamic importers must stall device access until observed write fences complete. They should publish fences for any access that cannot be halted promptly from invalidation callback. Generic reservation fence discipline remains compulsory.

Attachment operation set holds peer capability flag and optional move notification. Attachment record links buffer and device, list position, peer indicator, importer operation vector, importer private area and exporter private area.

Move notification runs while reservation lock is held and fresh mapping must also be requested under same lock, which excludes concurrent creation during relocation. When notification exists the framework may leave backing unpinned while mappings persist.

Export descriptor aggregates exporter label, owner, operation vector, length, flags, reservation object and private data. Helper macro builds zeroed descriptor prefilled with build module name and current module.
Reference helper bumps sharing file count. Dynamic test reports true exactly when exporter supplies pin hook.
DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL equals zero, DMA_TO_DEVICE equals one, DMA_FROM_DEVICE equals two, DMA_NONE equals three.
Direction validator accepts bidirectional plus both single directions and rejects none and any other value.
Translation window holds processor base, bus base and extent. Device map is array of windows closed by zero extent entry.

Forward scan returns bus base plus offset when processor address falls inside a window, otherwise error sentinel. Reverse scan returns processor base plus offset when bus address falls inside, otherwise all ones word. Both walk until terminating empty window.
Minimum helper starts from all ones and retains smallest bus base across windows. Maximum helper starts from zero and retains largest bus end computed as base plus extent minus one.
First configuration aliases both encrypted and unencrypted physical translation directly to generic physical translation.

Core converter uses window translation when device provides map, otherwise identity. Unencrypted and encrypted variants apply corresponding address adjustment after core step. Generic converter applies encrypted adjustment. Reverse converter canonicalizes bus value then uses window reverse or identity.
Default query reports that forced unencrypted handling is never required.

Capability test fails on error sentinel, on unshared request toward device demanding unencrypted path, on low memory underflow for narrow builds, and when end exceeds tighter of device mask and bus limit. Otherwise it passes.

Fence object pairs exclusive lock storage with operation vector, reusable completion storage, identity pair, flag word, reference count and error field. Lock is either external pointer or embedded guard. Completion storage starts as callback list, becomes timestamp at signal time, then becomes reclamation head at release time.

Order starts with DMA_FENCE_FLAG_INITIALIZED_BIT then DMA_FENCE_FLAG_INLINE_LOCK_BIT then DMA_FENCE_FLAG_SEQNO64_BIT then DMA_FENCE_FLAG_SIGNALED_BIT then DMA_FENCE_FLAG_TIMESTAMP_BIT then DMA_FENCE_FLAG_ENABLE_SIGNAL_BIT and ends with DMA_FENCE_FLAG_USER_BITS which stays last.
Callback record links list node with function pointer invoked at signal time.
Operation vector offers driver and timeline naming as compulsory, plus elective signaling enable, signal peek, custom wait, destruction and deadline hint.

Enable hook lets hardware oriented drivers defer interrupt or command setup until software waiter appears; false means already passed or enable impossible and may carry error. Peek hook reports signaled state as fast path with sticky true guarantee but may lag true completion. Both are elective.

Custom wait defaults to generic helper, is discouraged for new code, reports interruption restart and remaining time or timeout, and pins provider module by blocking detach. Destruction hook runs even in interrupt context and defaults to generic free; custom version demands reclamation safe backing. Deadline hint conveys preferred completion time for power tuning, may arrive repeatedly from any context without fence lock, and tracks earliest time with past meaning immediate.

Enable runs with interrupts masked so only interrupt safe guards are usable outside it. Deadline arrives without fence lock held and needs callee side guarding. Destruction may run in interrupt context.

Enable implementation should hold self reference until signal to close race where signal drops final count and frees memory. Custom wait and custom destruction both prevent detach after signal and require provider to remain loaded while fence lives. Callback list is valid only until signal sets timestamp; reading list or timestamp needs live reference, bare read lock is insufficient. List is cleared when last reference drops.

Initialization test checks presence and flag. Put releases one count through release path when pointer is present. Get adds count and returns same pointer. Read copy get succeeds only while count stays nonzero, otherwise yields absent.
Direct mapping guard defines _LINUX_DMA_DIRECT_H as one, direction guard defines _LINUX_DMA_DIRECTION_H, fence guard defines __LINUX_DMA_FENCE_H.

Exporter must not retain or share scatter description across calls; framework or importer owns caching. Transfer of ownership to caller and return via unmap must be honored or double use and leak arise.

Absent window coverage produces sentinel that always fails capability test, steering caller toward alternate pool. Reverse miss produces all ones address. Narrow address builds reject low memory below processor minimum. Mask and bus limit together bound usable top.
